findings.title: Speech stays within entrusted authority
findings.claim: The focus answer can be read as boundary-keeping testimony: the alleged saying is treated as an attribution to be answered, authorized speech is located in the command to worship God, and knowledge of the unseen remains with the encompassing knower.
findings.mechanism: The focus forms for saying, having a right, exonerating God, knowing, and the unseen meet the adjacent command, worship, lordship, and witness forms in 5:117 and the messenger-knowledge limit in 5:109. That contact changes the reply from a bare denial into an account of who may speak, what the speaker is entitled to say, and where knowledge ends.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the answer as an ordered testimony whose speech, authority, and knowledge each stop at a visible boundary while the ordinary denial remains fully intact.
findings.containment: This is a pericope-grounded channel-informed synthesis, not a surah-wide channel decision. It does not decide whether the attributed saying occurred; it keeps the question, the denial, and the alternative possibility of ordinary dialogue visible together.

epistemic.reason: The branch and context nomination is trusted and all cited contacts are supplied, but the channel text is still a nomination requiring this bounded writer assessment.

The closing sovereignty and capacity statement in 5:120 completes the distinction between granted efficacy and ultimate status.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the focus accusation as testing a category conversion from authorized ability to independent deity while still reading it plainly as a question about false divine attribution.
findings.containment: This finding is attributed to a legacy-unbound HFT trace. The packet also allows the surrounding miracle catalogue and the interrogation to function as adjacent reminders without specifying a causal error; that counter-reading remains live. Unresolved branch records supply no independent gloss or facet, so those activations remain attributed and bounded by their exact traces.

The contact changes the question from an isolated doctrinal label into a possible failure in how evidence is received.

findings.containment: This is an exploratory, legacy-unbound HFT inference. The supplied sequence may instead be adjacent faithful and unfaithful reception scenes without a specified causal arrow; that alternative remains visible. findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the disputed status as something people attempt to confer and organize, while the closing language supplies a concrete boundary around who possesses ultimate rule and power.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory institutional metaphor and does not replace the ordinary worship reading. It remains anchored in the supplied focus wording and 5:120; it does not claim a historical institutional structure or resolve the theological question by metaphor.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace has exact focus and closing-ayah coordinates and an explicit containment qualification, but the source is legacy-unbound and the office metaphor is marked exploratory.
